title: Publications manifest
description: Every place a venture has published (governance/publications.json): one entry per channel and artifact, naming the channel in governance/publication-policy.json, the artifact that was published (artifacts are what get published, records never are), where it went, the sha256 of the built output, the person who approved it, when, the versions before it (for naive publish rollback) and any embargo. node schema/check-publications.mjs fails when something is live without an entry, when an entry's sha256 does not match the built output, or when an entry has no approver.

artifact.description: The artifact id (artifacts/<id>.json) that is published

sources.description: The public MDX variants that compile to it, venture-relative

output.description: The built output, venture-relative, as naive publish build wrote it

sha256.description: The sha256 of the built output that is live

approved_by.description: The person who approved this version. Never an agent.

decision.description: The publish decision record that approved it (decisions/<file>)

not_before.description: An embargo: the gate refuses to publish before this time

stale.description: A record it was built from changed since it was published; rebuild, re-lint and republish

previous.description: Earlier live versions, newest first; naive publish rollback restores the first
